reasons: Native synthetic completion delivery is fully traceable and reusable only inside a live parent GatewayRunner/backend boundary.
AOTA Profile Task completion is produced in a separate hermes -z worker/finalizer process and currently terminates at a sanitized filesystem outbox.
Direct Python import does not transfer GatewayRunner, event loop, adapter registry, session DB handle, ownership context, or profile scope.
Direct async_delegations INSERT would require a fake native delegation lifecycle and is high risk.
A small trusted backend adapter can consume the existing outbox and invoke the existing gateway wake/normal-turn path, with explicit parent profile/session validation and durable idempotency.
recommended_integration_option: AOTA Completion to Hermes Parent Turn Backend Adapter
recommended_transport: existing AOTA sanitized outbox into backend; in-process gateway.wake where available, authenticated API self-post only as profile-aware fallback
recommended_persistence: existing AOTA pending/delivered outbox plus adapter delivery receipt/claim; do not insert async_delegations
recommended_authentication: trusted finalizer provenance, parent ownership/profile validation, API_SERVER_KEY for raw-session self-post
recommended_idempotency: stable AOTA event identity derived from task/start, adapter claim, duplicate suppression, at-least-once acknowledgment
aota_plugin_change_required: small schema alignment likely; existing outbox producer remains source of truth
